purpose: 展示 analyze 的配置输入、逐笔分值、原因顺序和真实 JSON 输出。
展示 trace-risk 分段求和、告警等值边界及 scoring:null 的真实退出码和错误输出。
output:
OPERATION trace-risk segment sum and alert boundary
INPUT {"transfers": [{"id": "t1", "timestamp": "2026-10-04T10:00:00Z", "chain": "eth", "asset": "ETH", "from_address": "A", "to_address": "B", "amount": 1.0, "usd_value": 10000}, {"id": "t2", "timestamp": "2026-10-04T10:10:00Z", "chain": "eth", "asset": "ETH", "from_address": "B", "to_address": "D", "amount": 1.0, "usd_value": 5000}], "whale_threshold_usd": 10000, "routes": [{"id": "equal", "min_score": 15, "severity": "warning", "chains": ["*"], "assets": ["*"], "target": "ops"}], "scoring": {"value_points_per_ratio": 10, "value_points_cap": 100}, "chain": "eth", "asset": "ETH", "start_address": "A", "end_address": "D", "max_hops": 4}
COMMAND python3 -m whale_radar trace-risk
EXIT 0
STDOUT {"paths": [{"nodes": ["A", "B", "D"], "transfer_ids": ["t1", "t2"], "hops": 2, "amount": 2, "usd_value": 15000, "score": 15, "reason": ["VALUE"], "path_id": "t1>t2"}], "alerts": [{"route_id": "equal", "path_id": "t1>t2", "severity": "warning", "score": 15, "reason": ["VALUE"], "target": "ops"}]}
